messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often must the KITO KR50L electric hoist at position 16 be verified?

response.text: Dato che l'azienda opera in aree minerarie (settore estrattivo), con quale frequenza deve essere verificato il paranco elettrico KITO KR50L in posizione 16?
